Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how FitCalcHub ("we," "us") handles information when you use this website.

Information We Collect

FitCalcHub's calculators run in your browser. The numbers you enter into a calculator (such as age, height, or weight) are used only to display your result and are not stored on our servers or shared with third parties.

Cookies and Analytics

We may use basic, privacy-conscious analytics to understand overall site traffic and improve the website. This data is aggregated and not used to identify individual visitors.

Contact Form

If you submit the contact form, the information you provide is used only to respond to your message.

Third-Party Links

Our site may link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated policy.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this policy, please visit our Contact page.
